name: neon
description: Decide when work warrants an isolated, 72-hour Neon database branch and manage it with official Neon tooling.

interface.longDescription: Decide whether a task needs database isolation, then create and manage a clearly scoped 72-hour branch through the official Neon integration, CLI, or API. No custom provisioning executable or global credential service is included.
defaultPrompt: Decide whether this work warrants an ephemeral Neon branch
Create a 72-hour Neon branch scoped to this repository and worktree
Inspect this task's temporary branch before deleting it
